text.arabic_uthmani: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَٱحْذَرُوا۟ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

baseline.text: Allah'a itaat edin, elçiye itaat edin ve sakının. Yüz çevirirseniz bilin ki elçimize düşen yalnızca açıkça bildirmektir.

findings.text: Elçinin açıkça iletmesi mesajı sınırına ulaştırır, fakat gönüllü itaati zorla alınan kabule dönüştürmez.

activation_trace.role: Submission and compliant following supply the positive orientation repeated toward God and the messenger.
Alert self-protection makes the warning an active maintenance of receptivity.
Turning away and withdrawing provide the negative movement that the vigilance is meant to catch.

changed_reading.after: Maintain a deliberately guarded orientation toward the divine command as carried by the messenger; the danger point is the recipient's own pivot from reception into withdrawal.
changed_reading.before: Obey two authorities, be careful, and do not refuse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled وَأَطِيعُوا, the imperative وَٱحْذَرُوا, and the conditional فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two obedience imperatives establish directed compliance, vigilance guards that orientation, and tawalli names the active pivot into withdrawal. The focus therefore contrasts maintained receptivity with a chosen break in receptivity rather than contrasting knowledge with simple ignorance.

activation_trace.role: The carrier and carried message supply the human relay whose duty is being bounded.
Arrival at an endpoint makes conveyance a completed transfer rather than an indefinitely controlled outcome.
Delivery of the message names the messenger's affirmative task.
Exposition by speech or sign makes the transferred content available for responsible reception.
The command to know turns the division of responsibility into knowledge demanded of the hearers.

changed_reading.after: Once carried speech reaches its audience in an inspectable form, the transfer itself marks a liability boundary: delivery remains on the messenger, while reception or refusal passes to the hearer.
changed_reading.before: The messenger only has to announce the teaching clearly.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَسُول recurs on both sides of the conditional, followed by إِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَاغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A messenger carries speech, balagh both delivers it and brings it to its endpoint, and mubin makes its meaning manifest. The restrictive إِنَّمَا عَلَى construction then uses completed, inspectable transfer to separate the messenger's obligation from the recipient's response.

activation_trace.role: Agreement and responsive alignment add a relational dimension to obedience.
Capacity and ability make compliance something enacted through available power.
The self's making an act easy supplies the inward enabling movement of willing response.
Turning the face toward something supplies the live alternative that tawalli can reverse.

changed_reading.after: The doubled command also solicits willing agreement and activated capacity; turning away is a reorientation of the very faculties that could have made response possible.
changed_reading.before: Obedience is external compliance with a command.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated imperative from ط و ع stands opposite the face-turning potential carried by و ل ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root inventory places compliance beside agreement, capacity, and the self's facilitation of an act. The imperative can therefore activate more than external submission: it calls for will, practical ability, and inward ease to be aligned with the directive, while tawalli reverses that alignment.

activation_trace.role: Alert protection is the focus mechanism that the nearby hazards specify.
Prohibition supplies the rejected overcorrection: obedience must not manufacture bans.
Crossing a limit supplies the opposite error, so vigilance holds a calibrated boundary.
A drink that covers the intellect supplies a material impairment of attentive response.
Diversion and turning away expose the blocker as a directional force against reception.
Keeping something present against forgetting names the attention that diversion interrupts.
Specified worship supplies the recurrent practice from which the blocker turns people.
Reaching an endpoint gives the preceding question the force of a demanded cessation immediately before the focus commands.

changed_reading.after: Guard the faculties and practices through which obedience remains possible, without confusing vigilance with self-made deprivation; the warning targets forces that cover judgment, fracture relations, and redirect attention.
changed_reading.before: Beware disobedience in a general sense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context first prohibits self-imposed prohibition of wholesome permissions and boundary-crossing, then identifies an intoxicant-driven chain that covers judgment, creates social hostility, and diverts people from remembrance and prayer. Focus caution is thus calibrated vigilance against concrete blockers of obedient attention, not free-floating scrupulosity or indiscriminate renunciation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibrated permissions, prohibitions, and a diversion chain; I supply the arrow from that chain to impaired receptivity in 5:92. A live alternative is that وَٱحْذَرُوا remains a general warning broader than these immediate hazards.
structural_cues: 5:87 rejects both invented prohibition and transgression, framing obedience between two distortions.
The causal sequence in 5:91 ends with فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّنتَهُونَ immediately before the focus opens with two obedience imperatives and a warning.

activation_trace.role: Responsive agreement supplies the focus disposition that the later sequence repeatedly renews.
Repeated heart-settling assent supplies recurrent inner orientation rather than a one-time declaration.
Intended action turns assent into enacted response.
Soundness opposed to corruption gives the repeated action its reparative direction.
Repeatedly placing oneself in protection operationalizes the focus warning as maintained discipline.
Doing the good supplies the sequence's outward culmination.

changed_reading.after: Obedience is a renewable sequence of assent, action, self-protection, and better action; vigilance is the maintenance operation that keeps response from decaying.
changed_reading.before: The doubled obey is an emphatic command at one moment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats belief, intentional action, and protective self-placement in a staged sequence, then culminates in doing what is good. This temporal recurrence turns the doubled focus imperative from mere emphasis into a maintainable practice that must be renewed across changing situations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition and temporal sequencing; I infer that this sequence models how the focus command is maintained through time. It could instead be read only as conditions local to 5:93.
structural_cues: 5:93 cycles through faith and action, marks further stages with ثُمَّ, and repeats protective vigilance three times.

activation_trace.role: Reaching an endpoint supplies the focus threshold whose practical force the hunt sequence activates.
A test that makes a condition appear supplies the disclosure function of the reachable prey.
Attainment and contact place the tested object within practical reach.
A state becoming known links enacted restraint to disclosure.
Anticipatory fear supplies restraint before an unseen consequence.
What is hidden from sight makes the restraint a test of orientation rather than reaction to surveillance.
The offering's required arrival at the Kaaba supplies a concrete endpoint for valid completion.

changed_reading.after: Balagh is arrival within actionable reach: once the directive reaches its endpoint clearly, the audience's restraint or withdrawal can disclose its orientation, even when the ultimate audit is unseen.
changed_reading.before: Balagh means that the messenger has successfully spoken to the audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hunt test brings an object within reach of hands and spears so that restraint toward the unseen can become observable, while the compensating offering must itself reach a designated endpoint. These spatial events activate focus balagh as an accountability threshold: when a directive or object arrives within actionable reach, response discloses the recipient's orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reach, test, disclosure, unseen restraint, and endpoint arrival; I infer that completed conveyance likewise creates an actionable threshold at which response becomes attributable. The alternative is that legal reach and communicative balagh remain separate mechanisms.
structural_cues: 5:94 places prey within reach of hands and spears and states a knowledge-producing purpose.
5:95 answers violation with a compensating object that must reach the Kaaba, repeating the packet's arrival logic materially.

activation_trace.role: The message carrier supplies the bounded human side of the accountability division.
The repeated carrier term marks 5:99 as an explicit reactivation of the focus boundary.
Message delivery is again isolated as the messenger's remit.
Divine knowing receives the interior-accountability role immediately after the delivery limit.
What emerges openly supplies one pole of the response known by God.
Concealment supplies the inaccessible pole that remains beyond public delivery.
Gathering dispersed messengers creates the later audit setting.
The carriers themselves become questioned participants rather than owners of the final account.
The answer received is the reception outcome about which the messengers are asked.
The denial and reassignment of knowledge make epistemic limits part of messenger accountability.
Hidden response remains under divine, not messenger, knowledge.

changed_reading.after: The system deliberately distributes knowledge and liability: the messenger owns faithful public transfer, the recipient owns response, and God alone audits both the exposed and concealed reception that no messenger can exhaustively control.
changed_reading.before: The messenger is not responsible if people reject the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim restatement in 5:99 assigns only conveyance to the messenger and immediately assigns knowledge of exposed and concealed response to God. The later gathering of messengers, their being asked how they were answered, and their deferral to the Knower of hidden things extend the same asymmetry into final audit: carriers deliver, but they do not own or exhaustively know reception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact duty formula, the open/hidden contrast, and the later messenger audit; I infer one distributed-accountability architecture across them. A live alternative is that the messengers' reply in 5:109 expresses deference rather than a strict epistemic limit.
structural_cues: 5:99 repeats مَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَاغُ and then contrasts disclosure with concealment.
5:109 stages a final audit in which messengers are asked about received response but defer hidden knowledge to God.

activation_trace.role: Exposition by speech or sign is the focus clarity whose scope the context qualifies.
Denied equivalence makes clarity perform a distinction rather than merely add information.
Inferiority opposed to wholesomeness supplies one side of the actionable distinction.
Wholesomeness opposed to impurity supplies the other side of the actionable distinction.
Demanding disclosure supplies the pressure toward unnecessary total exposure.
Emergence into view supplies the disclosure whose timing and usefulness are being constrained.
A proper time supplies the temporal boundary on manifestation.
Delivery of revelation supplies the authorized occasion for needed disclosure.

changed_reading.after: Clear conveyance gives the distinctions needed for response in their authorized time; it is actionable and inspectable without promising exhaustive or demand-driven exposure.
changed_reading.before: Clear conveyance means making every relevant matter fully explicit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The instruction to distinguish the impure from the wholesome makes clarity discriminative, while the following prohibition on questions whose answers would distress and its restriction of disclosure to the time of revelation make clarity temporally bounded. Mubin therefore need not mean exhaustive exposure of everything; it can mean enough manifest distinction, delivered at the right time, for responsible action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies discriminative contrast and timed disclosure; I infer that these qualify the function of مُبِين in the focus. The alternative is that 5:101 regulates burdensome inquiry without defining clarity itself.
structural_cues: 5:100 commands a categorical distinction despite the attractive abundance of one side.
5:101 immediately limits inquiry and makes manifestation conditional on the time of revelation.

activation_trace.role: The authorized message carrier supplies the source against which substitute norms are tested.
Invented falsehood supplies the production mechanism of unauthorized norms.
Opposition to truth marks the fabricated attribution as a source failure.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the missing audit faculty.
What is sent down and delivered supplies the authorized originating content.
The messenger supplies the authorized relay paired with what God sent down.
Claimed sufficiency closes inquiry and makes inherited practice function as a substitute authority.
Ancestral parentage supplies the transmission line preferred over the messenger.
Absent disclosed knowledge invalidates ancestry as a sufficient epistemic warrant.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the absent directional warrant.

changed_reading.after: Verify where a norm comes from: obedience keeps divine source and messenger relay aligned, while turning away often works by installing fabricated restrictions or inherited sufficiency in their place.
changed_reading.before: Obey God and the messenger rather than disobeying them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fabricated livestock rules are described as invented falsehood attributed to God, and the next scene answers a call to what God sent down and to the messenger with ancestral sufficiency despite absent knowledge and guidance. The doubled focus obedience becomes a source-authentication protocol: turning away is not neutral noncompliance but reassignment of normative authority to fabricated or inherited substitutes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, authorized descent and relay, and ancestral refusal; I infer that the focus's doubled obedience audits source provenance. A live alternative is that the passage targets only particular customs rather than a general authority mechanism.
structural_cues: 5:103 first rejects humanly invented restrictions falsely assigned to God.
5:104 then stages the exact alternative source pair, what God sent down and the messenger, and a refusal grounded in ancestral discovery.

activation_trace.role: Message delivery supplies the task explicitly placed upon the messenger.
The self as the thing's own identity supplies the recipient's assigned field of responsibility.
Another's departure from direction supplies the outcome that is not automatically transferred.
Direction toward the true path supplies the condition under which another's straying does not injure.
Return supplies the common endpoint at which distributed responsibilities are gathered for audit.
A delivered report supplies the final disclosure of what recipients did.
Intentional deeds identify what the final report concerns.

changed_reading.after: The limit positively allocates work: faithful transfer belongs to the messenger, self-tending response belongs to each hearer, and neither can absorb the other's task before the common return.
changed_reading.before: The messenger's limited duty simply excuses him from other people's refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places clear conveyance 'upon Our messenger'; 5:105 places the recipients' own selves 'upon you,' denies transfer of harm from another's straying when they are guided, and sends all back for a report of deeds. The mirrored assignments make responsibility distributive rather than contagious: the messenger must relay, each recipient must tend the self, and final reporting belongs at return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored عَلَى assignments and separate outcome clauses; I infer a distributed-liability design across the two ayat. The alternative is that عَلَيْكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ is an independent exhortation with no deliberate echo.
structural_cues: The focus's عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا is answered by 5:105's عَلَيْكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ.
5:105 distinguishes another's misdirection, one's own guidance, collective return, and individual deeds.

activation_trace.role: Delivery of a message supplies the transmission event that the legal procedure analogically stress-tests.
Making meaning known by speech or sign supplies the clarity that must remain inspectable.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies an accountable speech act.
Concealment names the principal integrity failure in transmission.
Discovery of what was hidden supplies an audit trigger.
Establishing and exposing the right supplies the corrective purpose of replacement testimony.
The proper face or sound aspect of a matter supplies fidelity of presentation.
Rejection or return of a defective claim supplies a procedural check against false acceptance.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the recipient-side completion of transmission.

changed_reading.after: Clear conveyance is an integrity-preserving relay: content must arrive without concealment or distortion, remain open to verification, and meet a hearer capable of understanding and compliance.
changed_reading.before: Clear conveyance is understandable wording delivered by the messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The testament procedure builds a custody chain for consequential speech: witnessed declaration, oath, prohibition of concealment, discovery of hidden breach, replacement testimony, presentation on its proper face, possible return of oaths, and commanded listening. This activates clear conveyance as fidelity that can be audited, challenged, and received, not merely fluent speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a legal integrity protocol; I map its custody and audit logic onto the focus's communicative balagh. This analogy is live but not compulsory, since the witness rules may remain domain-specific.
structural_cues: 5:106-108 forms a procedural chain from original testimony through concealment risk, discovery, replacement, and reception.
The closing وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ makes faithful hearing part of the procedure rather than leaving clarity entirely with the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Manifest appearance supplies the focus quality that does not force assent.
Manifest signs and the repeated clear predicate show clarity present at the point of rejection.
Covering the truth supplies a recipient operation that can defeat acknowledgment without erasing manifestation.
Diversion and deception supply the rejecting reclassification imposed on clear signs.

changed_reading.after: Clear delivery removes lack of presentation as an excuse but does not compel classification or assent; a recipient can actively cover or redescribe what has become manifest.
changed_reading.before: A sufficiently clear message should eliminate meaningful refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 5:110, manifest signs and the final predicate mubin coexist with rejection that redescribes them as deceptive magic. Clarity is therefore a property of what is presented, not a causal guarantee that recipients will classify or accept it correctly. The focus conditional 'if you turn away' remains fully possible after clear conveyance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarity language on both sides of a rejection event; I infer that manifestation and acceptance are causally separable. A live alternative is that the rejecters use مُبِين only to intensify their own false classification.
structural_cues: 5:110 places بِٱلْبَيِّنَاتِ before the rejecting speech and ends that speech with سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ.

activation_trace.role: Ability and practical capacity supply a latent dimension of the focus obedience root.
The explicit capacity question activates the ability branch beside the focus imperatives.
Sending and bringing the requested table to the recipients supplies demonstrative delivery.
Settling and reassurance name the affective capacity the requested sign is meant to produce.
The heart supplies the interior site whose readiness is being sought.
Disclosed knowledge supplies the epistemic result expected from arrival.
Truthful speech supplies the claim the sign is asked to confirm.
Presence with observation supplies the requested move from report to witness.
Covering truth after delivery supplies the aggravated failure at the new evidence threshold.

changed_reading.after: Clear delivery can enlarge the recipient's capacity, reassurance, and witness, but that gain is not neutral: once a requested verification threshold is crossed, turning away becomes a more accountable act.
changed_reading.before: Obedience follows an already complete act of explanation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same ط و ع inventory appears in a question about capacity to send down a table; the request then seeks heart-rest, knowledge, truth-confirmation, and witness, while denial after delivery receives heightened consequence. This reactivates focus obedience at a verification threshold: requests for more demonstrative delivery can increase practical capacity and certainty, but once the requested clarity arrives they also intensify accountable response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared root polysemy, requested delivery, stated verification effects, and heightened post-delivery consequence; I infer a threshold linking increased capacity to increased accountability. The live alternative is that the capacity sense in 5:112 should not color the obedience imperative at all.
structural_cues: 5:112 moves from a capacity question to a requested descent.
5:113 enumerates eating, heart-settling, knowing, truth-confirmation, and witnessing as desired results.
5:115 makes post-delivery rejection the condition for exceptional consequence.

activation_trace.role: The message carrier supplies a delegated role whose authority depends on faithful relay.
Delivery of the message supplies the bounded basis of messenger obedience.
The worshiped/deity branch marks the category error explicitly rejected in the audit.
Binding command supplies the upstream content Jesus says he alone relayed.
Submissive worship identifies God, not the messenger, as the object of the relayed command.
Lordship and sovereignty shared over messenger and audience preserve rank asymmetry.
Presence with observation limits the messenger's direct witness to the time he was among them.
Taking the person away marks the temporal endpoint of messenger observation.
Uninterrupted guarding transfers post-departure oversight to God.

changed_reading.after: The parallel action conceals a deliberate hierarchy: obedience to the messenger follows a faithfully delegated command, while worship, source authority, hidden knowledge, and unbounded oversight remain God's alone.
changed_reading.before: Repeating 'obey' places God and messenger as two parallel authorities, after which the messenger receives a limitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing audit rejects treating the messenger and his mother as deities; Jesus says he transmitted only what he was commanded, namely worship of God as his Lord and theirs, and limits his own witnessing to his period among them before divine watch continues. Thus the focus's repeated verb coordinates obedience without collapsing ranks: messenger obedience is derivative from faithful relay, while source authority and unrestricted oversight remain divine.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected deification, command relay, common Lordship, bounded presence, and continuing watch; I infer that these explain how the same obedience verb can address God and messenger without making their authority equivalent. The alternative is that 5:116-117 corrects only one historical excess without glossing the focus coordination.
structural_cues: 5:116 stages an accusation of unauthorized elevation and a denial grounded in divine knowledge.
5:117 uses the restrictive مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَمَرْتَنِى, then distinguishes temporary messenger witness from continuing divine watch.

remaining_uncertainties: The capacity sense activated by يَسْتَطِيعُ in 5:112 may illuminate the focus imperatives only by root play, not by their local verbal sense.
The testament custody chain strongly models auditable transmission, but its transfer from legal testimony to prophetic conveyance remains analogical.
The secondary س ط ع mapping supports a contained signal image but is too form-distant to carry interpretive weight without explicit qualification.
strongest_changes: The immediate context revises caution from generalized severity into calibrated protection of judgment, remembrance, worship, and social relation without inventing prohibitions.
Reach, testing, and endpoint arrival turn balagh into an actionable accountability threshold rather than speech alone.
The 5:99 and 5:109 echoes distribute delivery, response, and hidden knowledge among messenger, hearer, and God.
The source disputes in 5:103-104 and the audit in 5:116-117 make doubled obedience an authorized, hierarchical relay rather than two equivalent authorities.
Clarity becomes actionable but bounded and non-coercive: it can distinguish and manifest without exposing everything or compelling assent.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly re-instantiates the focus mechanism in different domains: behavioral inhibition, spatial reach, disclosure and concealment, inherited authority, legal testimony, requested demonstration, and final messenger audit. Exact verbal echoes at 5:99 and structural echoes at 5:105, 5:109, and 5:117 make bounded conveyance the organizing mechanism, while the table sequence activates the less expected capacity branch of ط و ع.

activation_trace.role: Extension and rising through the air supply the form-distant image of a projected signal.
Reaching an endpoint turns projection into successful arrival.
Manifest appearance turns arrival into a signal perceptible to its recipient.
Manifest signs that are nevertheless reclassified show that signal visibility and acceptance can diverge.

changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial analogy, the doubled command is a projected signal, balagh is its arrival, and mubin is its perceptibility; turning away is failure at reception rather than failure of propagation.
changed_reading.before: The verse issues commands and then limits the messenger's duty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary س ط ع mapping for the focus ط و ع occurrence rather than the ordinary obedience target. It remains packet-valid because the split target is explicitly supplied and its extension image coheres with focus arrival and manifestation. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial communication analogy, never as the lexical meaning of أطيعوا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled ط و ع occurrence is packet-mapped not only to compliance but also to س ط ع, beside focus ب ل غ and ب ي ن.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Willing compliance is separated from compelled reception.** `ط و ع B001` is willing yielding, `ح ذ ر B003` guarded readiness, `و ل ي B007` withdrawal, and `ب ل غ B002` conveyance. The messenger's duty reaches delivery; the hearer's response remains free to face or withdraw. I infer that warning protects agency without transferring responsibility back to the messenger.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Clear delivery reaches its endpoint without replacing receiver agency.** Fixed **ب ل غ / B002** (“conveying a message”) and **B001** (“reaching the limit”) define the messenger’s burden, while fixed **و ل ي / B007** (“turning away and withdrawal”) remains the addressees’ possible act. 5:90–5:91 supplied prohibition and mechanism; 5:93–5:95 turn to guarded conduct under test. I infer that once explanation reaches its assigned limit, obedience or withdrawal belongs to the receiver’s causal side. The ayah reads as a boundary of responsibility, not indifference to response.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:94 converted warning into a concrete test of receiver agency: after clear delivery, reachable game exposes whether caution governs action without visible enforcement.

words.gloss_range: opening coordinator tying 5:92 to the preceding warning and command sequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps 5:92 joined to the pressure of 5:90-91 and does not let the ayah sound like a fresh topic. It opens a coordinated mandate, so obeying, obeying again, and being vigilant arrive as the positive response to the preceding demand to desist.

topics.headline: prior warning carried into command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command sequence continues the pressure of 5:90-91 instead of opening a detached subject.
topics.reason: The particle is licensed by QAC and clause evidence as a connector in this local sequence, so the rows are preserved as discourse structure rather than lexical root meaning.

topics.headline: coordinated command unit begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first beat of a coordinated command unit rather than an explanatory aside.
topics.reason: The contextual and inter-ayah rows cohere with the local clause sequence for {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}); concrete references are retained where they shape the payoff.

words.gloss_range: Form IV plural imperative of willing obedience directed to {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}})
words.prose: {{ar:أَطِيعُوا۟}} ({{tr:aṭīʿū}}) is a plural imperative directed to {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}), so obedience is an action addressed to the named divine object. The {{ar:ط و ع}} ({{tr:ṭ-w-ʿ}}) field keeps the command in willing compliance, and Form IV gives that willingness outward direction. Since the verb is repeated for the messenger, this first occurrence begins a doubled obedience architecture rather than governing both recipients at once.
words.root_gloss_range: willing compliance and yielding; locally outward-directed obedience rather than coercion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the named divine object of the first obedience command

topics.headline: willing compliance made active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels obedience as willing alignment given outward direction.
topics.reason: V4 and contextual evidence support the lexical pressure attached to {{ar:ط و ع}} ({{tr:ṭ-w-ʿ}}); the local prose states the positive payoff without expanding beyond this word.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God and the messenger are not folded under one shared verb.
topics.reason: The contextual and inter-ayah rows cohere with the local clause sequence for {{ar:أَطِيعُوا۟}} ({{tr:aṭīʿū}}); concrete references are retained where they shape the payoff.

The broader divine-name dispute supplies worship and devotion pressure, but the local grammar selects the named divine referent rather than a generic deity sense. Its first-object position establishes the hierarchy that the second obedience command preserves without collapsing.
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship and devotion pressure; locally the named divine object, not a generic deity term

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first obedience fixed on the known divine referent.
topics.reason: The aligned QAC and attachment evidence support this local function for {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}); the CRITICAL rows are preserved under that grammatical or form-specific payoff.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses worship and devotion behind the name while retaining the local direct-object function.
topics.reason: The broader root or derivational field is real, but local grammar and context narrow it for {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}); the surviving pressure is retained without replacing the selected sense.

topics.headline: first object frames hierarchy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees messenger obedience as second and distinct under the prior divine object.
topics.reason: The contextual and inter-ayah rows cohere with the local clause sequence for {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}); concrete references are retained where they shape the payoff.
